# A data component's events, run on every target a test can execute on: a
# handler a record holds writes the caller's state when the container calls
# it, and a raise in one reaches the caller's boundary rather than the
# container's.
#
# testdata/family_data_events.txtar is the code; this is the answer.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component action(label string, @run(), @pick(n int)) action

// Runs every record's handlers: the container acting on what it was handed,
// under a boundary of its own.
component bar(actions ...component action, controls component(fire func()) node) node {
    var inner = ""
    vbox {
        boundary(@error(e) {
            inner = e.message
        }) {
            controls(func() {
                for var a = actions {
                    a.run()
                    a.pick(a.label.length)
                }
            })
        }
        text(value=inner)
    }
}

component main node {
    var count = 0
    var picked = 0
    var names = ["x", "yy"]
    vbox {
        bar #b {
            action(label="inc", @run {
                count = count + 1
            })
            action(label="none")
            for var n = names {
                action(label=n, @pick(k) {
                    picked = picked + k * 10 + n.length
                })
            }
            component controls(fire) {
                button #all(text="all", @click {
                    fire()
                })
            }
        }
        text(value="{count} {picked}")
    }
}

component failing node {
    var caught = ""
    var after = false
    vbox {
        boundary(@error(e) {
            caught = e.message
        }) {
            bar #b {
                action(label="boom", @run {
                    error.raise("boom", "test")
                    after = true
                })
                component controls(fire) {
                    button #all(text="all", @click {
                        fire()
                    })
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testHandlersHeldByRecordsRun(t Test, c main) {
    c.b.all.click()
    t.assert(c.count == 1)
    t.assert(c.picked == 33)
}

func testARaiseReachesTheCallersBoundary(t Test, c failing) {
    c.b.all.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == "boom")
    t.assert(!c.after)
}

window {
    main
    failing
}
